---
title: "Where should I start?"
---

The HMT archive is large and complex. Rather than try to produce a comprehensive HMT app, I am experimenting with numerous small, focused apps. The [list of currently running apps](../apps/) has grown to the point it might not be obvious how to get started. Here are some suggestions.




- if you want to browse the HMT project's collection of manuscripts images: try [images.html](https://neelsmith.github.io/hmt-apps/images.html)
- if you want to read editions of the *Iliad* and *scholia*: try [iliad-scholia.html](https://neelsmith.github.io/hmt-apps/iliad-scholia.html)
- if you want a fascimile view of our most completely edited manuscript, the Venetus A: try [va-facsimile.html](https://neelsmith.github.io/hmt-apps/va-facsimile.html)
